CREATIVE ARTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   B. Damage equipment used for Football.
   C. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Football.
